title: UIAO OrgPath Binding Profile — Vendor-Neutral Facet Storage Contract
description: Machine-readable per-target declaration of where each OrgPath codebook facet lives on a platform. Per ADR-098, the 15-facet codebook (UIAO_151) defines what facets mean; a binding profile defines where each facet is stored (an attribute name, a tag key, a label key, a custom-attribute id) and how it is read/written at the Moderate/Commercial boundary. The Microsoft onPremisesExtensionAttribute1..15 slot table fixed by ADR-078 is recast as the microsoft-entra reference profile. Normative source: UIAO_193 §Binding-profile schema. Facet existence against the codebook, locator uniqueness per plane, and overflow-ordering integrity are enforced at load time by uiao.modernization.orgtree.binding_profiles, not in JSON Schema.

schema_version.description: Binding-profile schema version (independent of the codebook version). Major pinned to 1.

document_id.description: Binding profiles are executable canon under the UIAO_193 allocation, the way codebook.yaml is under UIAO_151.

profile_id.description: Kebab-case stable identifier (microsoft-entra, aws, gcp, okta, ldap, vmware). Never renamed; retire via status=deprecated + successor.

status.description: reference = the canonical worked example (microsoft-entra); proposed = specified, no shipped transport; active = transport shipped and in use; deprecated = retiring, must name successor.

boundary.description: Per ADR-098 the only permitted boundaries are Moderate and Commercial. The commercial cloud value also serves GCC-Moderate per ADR-033. High-side values require a superseding ADR and a schema change.

planes.description: Which planes this profile binds. A facet may bind once per plane (e.g. vmware binds department on identity, workload, and enforcement).

endpoint_resolution.description: Name of the resolution seam (never a hardcoded host) the profile's transport uses to reach the target at the declared boundary.

facet_bindings.description: One entry per (facet, plane). Facet names must exist in the codebook; (plane, locator) pairs must be unique. Both enforced by the loader.

overflow.description: Required when the target cannot store all bound facets natively on some plane. Declares the deterministic rule; never silently drop facets.

constraints.description: Native platform limits the transport must respect.

max_keys.description: Maximum locator keys the platform allows per object (e.g. a resource-tag cap).

value_charset.description: Regex describing the characters the platform accepts in values (e.g. GCP labels: ^[a-z0-9_-]*$). The mapping layer normalizes; the profile records the constraint.

notes.description: Profile-level caveats (e.g. tenant-override modes, product-surface naming policy).

facet.description: Codebook facet name (snake_case). Must exist in codebook.yaml — enforced by the loader.

plane.description: Which plane this binding applies to. Optional for single-plane profiles (defaults to the profile's only plane); required by the loader when the profile declares multiple planes.

locator.description: Native storage key on this target: attribute name, tag key/category, label key, or custom-attribute id.

locator_kind.description: What species of native storage the locator names.

writable.description: Whether the write-back transport may set this locator. false = read-only source surface.

notes.description: Per-facet caveats (length truncation, value normalization, scope/category mechanics).

rule.description: priority = store the highest-priority facets per `ordering`; the rest surface as DRIFT-IDENTITY uncaptured. composite-secondary = store primary facets natively and pack overflow into one reserved composite key, parsed back on read; secondary mechanism only, never replaces native storage for primary facets (ADR-078 rationale).

plane.description: Which plane the overflow rule applies to (the constrained one). Optional for single-plane profiles.

ordering.description: Required when rule == priority. Facets stored natively first, in order; must be a subset of the profile's bound facets (loader-enforced).

composite_locator.description: Required when rule == composite-secondary. The single reserved key holding the packed overflow (facet=value;…). Must not collide with any facet binding's locator (loader-enforced).
